text: SOP. Exception Handling Cases outside standard scope require supervisor sign-off before proceeding. Validation Confirm the account/system reflects the expected end state before the case is closed, and obtain customer confirmation where applicable. Escalation Escalations beyond first-line resolution are logged with a unique ticket reference and routed to the relevant specialist team, with an SLA acknowledgement sent to the customer within 24 hours. SLA / Timing First-line resolution target is same working day; escalations to specialist teams carry a 2-3 working day SLA. Audit Requirements Every action taken under this SOP must be logged against the account with agent ID, timestamp, and outcome for audit and quality-review purposes.
